body.name: Deterministic-sine and recorded-IPW hybrid estimator
body.construction:
Define the deterministic sine frame \(Q^{\mathrm D}\in\mathbb R^{n\times r}\) by
\[
 Q^{\mathrm D}_{is}=\sqrt{\frac{2}{n+1}}
 \sin\!\left(\frac{\pi i s}{n+1}\right),
 \qquad i\in I,\quad s\in\{1,\ldots,r\}.
\]
Define
\[
 a^{\mathrm{loose}}_{nm}=\sqrt{\frac n{\mu r}}
 \left[1\wedge\frac B{\lambda_{nm}}
 \left\{\sqrt{\frac{(n\vee m)\log(e(n+m))}{q}}
 +\frac{\log(e(n+m))}{q}\right\}\right].
\]
The observed-data hybrid estimator is
\[
 \widehat U^{\mathrm H}=
 \begin{cases}
 \widehat U^{\mathrm I},&a^{\mathrm{loose}}_{nm}\le1,\\
 Q^{\mathrm D},&a^{\mathrm{loose}}_{nm}>1.
 \end{cases}
\]
The branch is deterministic because it depends only on the declared dimensions and class parameters.
inputs: The dimensions and declared class parameters, together with the recorded IPW--SVD fit.
